description: Live foreign-exchange rates for one or many currency pairs (e.g. EUR/USD, EUR/RON, USD/JPY) with mid, indicative bid/ask, source attribution, timestamp and confidence. ECB-derived reference rates, cached 30 seconds. Use for pricing, conversions and finance agents. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.
